title: Builders in Velachery: Flood-Safe House Construction on Low Ground

seo.metaTitle: Builders in Velachery | House Construction | Hunter Property
seo.metaDescription: Building in Velachery? We set the plinth against past flood levels, test the soil and plan the sump and drainage before design. Get a flood-aware quote.

excerpt: Velachery sits on low ground, so the plinth level is the decision that outlasts every other. This guide covers the water, soil, sump and drainage choices, and why the budget runs above average here.
faqTitle: Building in Velachery: questions owners ask

faqs.question: What do your house construction packages cost in Velachery?
faqs.answer: Our packages are priced per sq ft of built-up area: Basic ₹2,199, Standard ₹2,399, Premium ₹2,699 and Ultra Luxury ₹3,199. Approvals, soil test, compound wall, sump and interiors are quoted separately. On low-lying plots, a deeper foundation for poor soil and a higher plinth add structure you will not see, so we show both at estimate stage rather than at excavation.

faqs.question: Who approves a house plan in Velachery?
faqs.answer: For a typical individual house in Velachery, the building permit comes from the Greater Chennai Corporation; larger buildings go to CMDA. We prepare the drawings and handle the submission, with the approval fees quoted separately.

faqs.question: Will road relaying affect my plinth in Velachery?
faqs.answer: It can. Roads are relaid and rise over time, so a plinth set flush with today’s road may sit below it in ten years. We set the plinth against the historic water line and the likely road level, not today’s road.

faqs.question: Where should the electrical board go in a Velachery house?
faqs.answer: Above the plinth and sensibly high, together with the meter. It costs nothing at design stage and keeps the supply safe if water ever reaches floor level.

faqs.question: How do you deal with rainwater on a Velachery plot?
faqs.answer: By keeping it on your plot. Rain off the roof and paving needs somewhere to go other than the lane, so our layouts plan site drainage before the drawings are finished.
